
  ▲ vercel [options] <command | path>

  For deploy command help, run `vercel deploy --help`

  Commands:

    Basic

      deploy           Deploy your project to Vercel (default)
      build            Build the project
      cache            Manage cache for a Project
      dev              Starts the `vercel dev` server
      env              Interact with Environment Variables for a Project
      git              Manage your Git repository connection to the current
                       Project
      help             Show help for a command
      init             Initialize example Vercel Projects
      inspect          Show information about a deployment
      install          Install an integration from the marketplace (alias for
                       `integration add`)
      integration      Manage marketplace integrations
      link             Link a local directory to a Vercel project
      list             List deployments
      login            Sign in to your Vercel account
      logout           Sign out the currently authenticated user
      open             Opens the current project in the Vercel Dashboard
      promote          Promote an existing Deployment to current
      pull             Pull Environment Variables and project settings into
                       .vercel
      redeploy         Rebuild and deploy a previous deployment
      rollback         Quickly revert back to a previous deployment
      signup           Create a Vercel account and sign in
      switch           Switch to a different team

    Advanced

      activity         List user activity events
      agent            Generate an AGENTS.md file with Vercel deployment best
                       practices
      agent-runs       Inspect Agent Runs observability data
      ai-gateway       Manage AI Gateway resources
      alerts           List alert groups or inspect a group
      alias            Interact with deployment aliases
      api              Make authenticated HTTP requests to the Vercel API
      bisect           Bisect the current project interactively or via an
                       automated test script
      blob             Interact with Vercel Blob
      budgets          Show and manage Spend Management for on-demand charges
                       after included credit [beta]
      buy              Purchase Vercel products for your team
      certs            Interact with SSL certificates
      changelog        Show the latest Vercel product updates
      ci               Inspect Vercel CI and rerun runs
      comments         Review and act on Vercel Toolbar comments from the
                       command line
      connect          Manage connectors
      contract         Show contract information for all billing periods
      crons            Manage cron jobs for a project [beta]
      curl             Make curl requests to Vercel deployments with automatic
                       protection bypass
      daemons          Manage daemons for a project [beta]
      deploy-hooks     Manage deploy hooks for Git-triggered builds
      dns              Interact with DNS entries for a project
      domains          Manage domains
      environments     Manage custom environments for a Project
      feedback         Send bugs, friction, and feature requests to the Vercel
                       team
      firewall         Manage your project's firewall rules, IP blocks, and
                       system bypass configuration
      flags            Manage feature flags for a Vercel project
      global-config    Manage Global Config stores (dashboard API parity)
      health           Show the current Vercel platform status and recent
                       incidents
      httpstat         Execute httpstat with automatic deployment URL and
                       protection bypass to visualize HTTP timing statistics
      kms              Manage KMS issuers, signing keys, and project grants
                       [beta]
      logs             Display logs
      mcp              Set up MCP agents and configuration for Vercel
                       integration
      metrics          Query observability metrics for your Vercel project or
                       team
      microfrontends   Manage microfrontends groups that compose multiple
                       projects into one cohesive application
      monitors         Create, inspect, list, update, and delete monitors and
                       manage their notification destinations
      organizations    Manage Vercel organizations
      pricing          Show Hobby, Pro, and Enterprise features from the public
                       Vercel pricing table
      project          Manage your Vercel projects
      redirects        Manage redirects for a project
      remove           Delete deployment(s) by project name or deployment ID
      rolling-release  Rolling releases gradually shift traffic to a new
                       deployment in stages, allowing you to monitor for errors
                       before serving all traffic
      routes           Manage routing rules for a project
      sandbox          Interact with Vercel Sandbox
      schedules        Manage schedules for the current project [beta]
      security         Inspect the security posture of the current team
      setup            Set up your machine for Vercel: install the Vercel plugin
                       for Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode and connect local
                       coding agents to the AI Gateway
      skills           Discover agent skills relevant to your project
      storage          Create, connect, and manage storage resources (Blob,
                       Global Config, Marketplace, and 1P) for your Projects
      teams            Manage Teams under your Vercel account
      telemetry        Allows you to enable or disable telemetry collection
      token-pass       Set up a coding agent with Vercel Token Pass
      tokens           Manage your personal Vercel authentication tokens
      traces           Fetch project traces and search spans across a Vercel
                       team
      upgrade          Upgrade the current global or native Vercel CLI
                       installation
      usage            Show billing usage and costs for the current billing
                       cycle or a custom date range
      vcr              Manage Vercel Container Registry repositories and images
                       (see `vcr image`)
      version          Manages the installed Vercel CLI version
      webhooks         Manage webhooks
      whoami           Shows the username of the currently logged in user

  Global Options:

    -h, --help                     Output usage information
    -v, --version                  Output the version number
    --changelog                    Show the 5 latest Vercel product updates
    --cwd                          Current working directory
    -A FILE, --local-config=FILE   Path to the local `vercel.json` file
    -Q DIR, --global-config=DIR    Path to the global `.vercel` directory
    -d, --debug                    Debug mode (default: off)
    --no-color                     No color mode (default: off)
    --non-interactive              Run without interactive prompts (default: on when an agent is detected)
    -S, --scope                    Set a custom scope
    -t TOKEN, --token=TOKEN        Login token

  Examples:

  – Deploy the current directory

    $ vercel

  – Deploy a custom path

    $ vercel /usr/src/project

  – Deploy with Environment Variables

    $ vercel --env NODE_ENV=production

  – Show the usage information for the sub command `list`

    $ vercel help list

  – Show the 5 latest Vercel product updates

    $ vercel --changelog

  – Search Vercel product updates

    $ vercel changelog search "AI SDK"
